name: Retraction Review Queue
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: When you type the path of a vault CSV, separate its folders with forward slashes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Retraction Review Queue is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
